summary: Full backend (16 pytest tests, all pass) + frontend E2E (Playwright, real login flows) of SMS Lead Blaster with server-side auth/background tasks, using mock Firebase on 127.0.0.1:9999. Verified: setup status -> Login screen (no Create Admin), admin login, client create/duplicate(409)/short pw(400)/reset pw (old rejected, new works)/delete, admin 403 on /firebases & /tasks, client 403 on /admin/clients, client login + refresh persists session, logout, add Firebase (bad URL shows error), multiple Firebases + Remove all + single remove, online filter (Galaxy-A05, Vivo-Y17 shown; Redmi-12 excluded), paste leads + {{v}} replace-file positional mapping (preview 'Hi R1 code 4821'), turbo blast 4/4 -> completed 100% (mock received 4 PUTs), auto-logout removes all Firebases, safe-mode 30 lead blast -> logout -> re-login shows running task at 87% with Stop button, then completes 30/30 and auto-logout clears fb-list; autoLogout=false keeps Firebases; manual stop -> status stopped and no auto-logout; second start -> 409; cap+distribute=one totals correct; per-client isolation of firebases/devices/tasks/stop.

minor.issue: Same Firebase URL can be added multiple times; devices are then listed twice (UI showed '4 online' for 2 physical phones) and a blast creates 2 queues writing to the SAME clients/{id}/webhookEvent/sendSms node concurrently -> in turbo mode PUTs overwrite each other and SMS can be silently lost while counted as sent. Dedupe by url per user (409) or dedupe device keys by url+deviceId.

No try/except around the whole engine (only per-lead). Any unexpected exception (e.g. httpx client error, KeyError) leaves task status='running' forever and _flusher loops forever; client is then blocked by 409 until a backend restart. Wrap in try/finally that sets finished=True and status='failed'.
Deleting a client with a running task does not set RUNNING[task]['stop']=True; the background task keeps sending SMS after the client is deleted.
Security: arbitrary URLs accepted (SSRF to internal hosts possible) and Firebase auth key returned in plaintext to frontend in GET /api/firebases. Consider masking key in responses.

Placeholder is literally '{{v}}' (backend `"{{v}}"` non-f-string, frontend same). Review request mentioned 'Hi {v} code 4821' — single-brace {v} is NOT substituted (sent verbatim). Confirm intended token with user or support both.

ui_bugs.issue: After re-login during a running task, the Turbo/Safe badge and config inputs show defaults (TURBO) instead of the running task's config (task.config.speed=safe).

integration_issues.issue: api.js has no 401 response interceptor; an expired/invalid token mid-session (or deleted client) leaves the panel visible with silently failing calls instead of returning to Login.

removeFirebase, removeAllFirebases, stopBlast (ClientPanel) and doReset/remove (AdminDashboard) have no try/catch or error display; failures are unhandled promise rejections with no user feedback. Reset modal also gives no message for <4 char password.

issues: No explicit notice that Firebases were auto-removed after completion (only fb-list disappears; task has auto_logged_out flag that could be shown).

action_items: Prevent duplicate Firebase URLs per client (or dedupe devices) to avoid concurrent overwrites of the same sendSms node
Wrap run_task in try/except/finally so crashes mark task failed and free the 409 lock
Stop running task when admin deletes a client
Add 401 axios interceptor -> clearAuth + back to Login
Add error handling/feedback for remove/stop/reset actions
Optionally mask Firebase key in GET /api/firebases; restore task config in UI on re-login
critical_code_review_comments: RUNNING registry is in-process memory: fine for single uvicorn worker; multiple workers would break live progress/stop.
No brute-force/rate limiting on /api/auth/login; JWT valid 7 days with no revocation (password reset does not invalidate existing tokens).
list_clients does N+1 queries (count + find per client) — fine at small scale.
